0022600115.text: The Minnesota Timberwolves, 2-0 and third in the Northwest and sixth in the West, host the 2-0 Toronto Raptors, who sit second in the Atlantic and fourth in the East, in Minnesota's third game of the 2026-27 season. Minnesota is 2-0 on the road and riding a two-game winning streak, but Donte DiVincenzo is out after Achilles surgery, while Toronto is without Brandon Ingram (heel surgery) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture). The teams have not met yet this season, but the Timberwolves won both meetings in the 2025-26 season, most recently a 115-107 victory in Minneapolis.
